name: Alpha-Level Risk
summary: Once per long rest, you may cast one Major Power as Empowered without the additional Empowered Warp Pressure cost. After resolving the power, roll for Perils twice if Perils triggers and use the higher severity result. This feature should feel powerful, frightening, and narratively dangerous.
